pages.text: $(bold)Multifunctional Drone$()$(br)Place it, bind it with the $(bold)Drone Controller$(), then right-click it to open the control panel.$(br2)Powered, it hovers and its rotors spin; cut the power and it settles gently down. On its own it only flies to the centre of its auto-range.
$(bold)Drone Controller$()$(br)Right-click a drone to bind it; afterwards any right-click opens the panel - unbind, set auto-range, first-person piloting, power.

$(bold)Five Modules (one module slot)$()$(br)$(bold)Care$(): auto-refills troughs with food and water, fertilizes crops, and moves eggs from coops into the incubating slot.$(br2)$(bold)Combat$(): while piloting, lets you use the item in the use slot and fire projectiles with the mouse buttons.$(br2)$(bold)Harvest$(): auto-harvests ripe crops in range into the nearest container.$(br2)$(bold)Transport$(): put a $(bold)Cardboard Box$() in the use slot and the drone flies to the centre of its range to drop the cargo, then returns.$(br2)$(bold)Highlight$(): while piloting, right-click a block to highlight it - the outline shows through blocks.
$(bold)Cardboard Box$()$(br)Cargo for transport mode; the drone delivers it, cargo and all, to the target coordinates.
